title: 第十九章 袭龙战阵第二十章 我输了

read2（）;“嗡”
兀自站定的林无缺双目紧闭，浑身淡金色圣道战气奔腾不休，金红气血澎湃不止！
身后那淡银魄月轻轻颤动，浮浮沉沉，与人齐高，此刻夜色渐浓，却从林无缺周身散发出灿烂的光芒，这光芒中更带着一股让人捉摸不透的磅礴气息。
林璎珞看着双目紧闭的林无缺，冰冷的眸子里闪过丝丝藏不住的震惊，因为在她的感知里，刚刚凝聚魄月踏入洗凡英魄境的林无缺让她无法看透！
准确的说，现在的林无缺看起来是洗凡英魄境初期的修士没错，但浑身上下总是若有若无的散发着让林璎珞感觉到一丝心悸的气息，仿佛眼前的少年化作了一条深海中的蛟龙，龙入大海，自此脱胎换骨一般！
司马傲眉头微皱，细细打量着林无缺，很显然，后者凝聚魄月踏入洗凡英魄境初期后给他同样带来些许触动。
“嗡”
半响之后，圣道战气缓缓平息下来，林无缺睁开了眼睛，虽然表情依旧平静，但目光深处亦是有着丝丝喜意。
紧握双拳，感受着体内浑厚了几倍的圣道战气，凝聚魄月突破至洗凡英魄境之后，林无缺感觉自己比之先前的锻体大圆满，足足要强上数倍！
他可以感觉，若是以他现在的战力再去对决慕容天，林无缺有着绝对的信心可以一拳打爆慕容天！
“嗡”
F8，首1）发i
身后的魄月让林无缺有种无比新奇之感，浮浮沉沉却从中散发着阵阵清凉无比的舒适之意，在这感觉之下，林无缺明白自己可以随时保持着清醒的意识和冷静的心。
“好！很好！你三人的表现真是出乎我的意料之外！果然都是天才！哈哈哈哈……”
齐世龙饱含赞赏的笑声响起，三人心中一动，各自抱拳对着齐世龙就是一礼：“感谢城主的栽培之恩！”
林无缺、司马傲、林璎珞三人都明白，此番能够有机缘突破，全都是来自于齐世龙的栽培，若没有他，他们三人根本不可能在短短的七日之内突破原有的修为！
对于齐世龙，林无缺三人此刻是发自内心的由衷感激。
“呵呵，你们无需谢我，这一次你们三人代表我龙光主城参加百城大战，我作为城主，自然要出一份力。好了，你们都是刚刚突破，体内的元力还很虚浮，今夜，你们将境界巩固，明日，我们还有其他的事要做。”
三人点点头，各自找到一处盘膝而坐，缓缓地进入到巩固修为的状态当中。

“嗡”
感受着体内浑厚至少三倍的圣道战气，林无缺深吸一口气，洗凡英魄境初期的波动四溢开来，全身心的投入到修炼当中。
齐世龙轻轻走到元力河流池子的旁边，望着池子当中的乳白色液态，眼神中的玩味之色渐起。
“整个元力河流少了大概三分之一，这三分之一当中只有三成是被林璎珞和司马傲吸收的，剩下的七成全部被林无缺吸收！呵呵，一个锻体境的小家伙凝聚魄月竟然会吸收如此惊人的元力，看来他升月的过程耗费了大量的元力。不知道此子七魄之间的距离是多少，一般的天才不过二三丈，我记得第一主城的那个妖孽似乎有六丈！七魄之间的距离越大，升月的过程也就越艰难，耗费的元力也会越多，但升月后的实力也会越强大。”
“以他吸收元力的强度来看，七魄之间的距离至少不会低于五丈，或许能够达到六丈也不一定。七魄之间的极限距离应该是九丈，不知道会是怎样的少年天才才能到达那样的高度啊……”
脑海中浮现出君山烈的影子，不过齐世龙最终还是摇了摇头：“君山烈虽然是绝世天才，但也不可能达到七魄九丈的极限……”
林无缺静静的修炼着，从他开始准备凝聚魄月时，空就没有说过话，似乎将一切都交给了林无缺自己，而它只是在一旁静静的看着，对此，林无缺也已经习惯。
“嗡”
随着圣道战气的流转，林无缺沉寂的心神缓缓和圣道战气来到了丹田之处。
斗战圣法本源依旧和过去一样，似乎没有发生过什么变化，林无缺仔细感觉了一会儿，仍然什么都没有发现。慢慢收敛心神，林无缺完全沉浸到巩固境界的修炼当中……
日出而升，清晨的朝阳散发出温暖的光芒，整个小山顶上仿佛被镶上了一层淡淡的金边。
三个各自修炼了一夜的年轻人端坐于温暖的阳光中，身后三轮魄月浮浮沉沉，各自散发出属于洗凡境修士特有的波动。
林璎珞是第一个结束修炼的，站在小山顶上，性子冰冷的少女远望着天边的朝阳，蓝色的贴身武裙紧紧包裹凹凸有致的身材，虽然还略带青涩，却在不经意间散发出惊人的魅力。
睁开眼睛的司马傲目光迷恋的看着林璎珞，少女微微抬起的精致侧脸在阳光的照耀下，宛如从天而降的女神一般，白皙的肌肤吹弹可破，绝美的小脸虽然没有笑容，依旧清冷，却怡然静谧，这一刻，在司马傲的眼中，林璎珞仿佛就成了永恒。
“呼”
一口浊气吐出，迎着朝阳，林无缺同样结束了一夜的修炼，睁开的眸子神采十足，漆黑的瞳孔里似乎隐有一丝幽幽金芒一闪而逝。
长身而起，林无缺负手而立，同样望向天边渐起的朝阳，温暖的阳光破开千万阻挡，将它的热情释放到无尽的远方。
“真美啊……”
忍不住轻轻开口，林无缺神色悠然，只是这句话恰巧被离他不远的林璎珞听了去。
少年的这三个字仿佛带着魔力，刹那间犹如在少女平静的心湖上投下了一块小小的石子，带起一圈一圈泛着细波的涟漪……不知何时，林璎珞那冰冷的小脸上闪过一抹红润，她不知道林无缺的三个字是在说这朝阳还是在说她……

“好了，一夜修炼，想必你们的修为也已经巩固的差不多了，距离百城大战的开始还有二十多天，时间紧迫，你们随我来……”
浩荡的元力瞬间笼罩了三人的身影，齐世龙带着林无缺三人腾空而去，消失在小山顶上。

Lin Wuque stood still with his eyes closed tightly, his whole body filled with pale golden Holy Path fighting energy, and his golden and red energy and blood surged endlessly!
The pale silver moon behind him trembled gently, floating and sinking, as high as the person. At this moment, the night was getting darker, but a brilliant light was emitted from Lin Wuque's body, and this light contained an unpredictable and majestic aura.
Lin Yingluo looked at Lin Wuque, who had his eyes closed tightly, and a hint of shock flashed through his cold eyes, because in her perception, she couldn't see through Lin Wuque, who had just condensed his soul moon and stepped into the realm of Xifan Yingshi!
To be precise, the current Lin Wuque looked like a monk in the early stage of the Pure Mortal Heroic Realm, but his whole body always exuded a vague aura that made Lin Yingluo feel a little palpitated, as if the young man in front of her had turned into a dragon in the deep sea, entered the sea, and been reborn!
Sima Ao frowned slightly and looked at Lin Wuque carefully. It was obvious that the latter had also touched him a little after he condensed the soul moon and entered the early stage of Xifan Yingpo realm.
"Buzz"
After a while, the fighting spirit of the Holy Path slowly calmed down, and Lin Wuque opened his eyes. Although his expression was still calm, there was also a hint of joy deep in his eyes.
Clenching his fists, feeling the fighting energy of the Holy Path that was several times thicker in his body, after condensing the Soul Moon and breaking through to the Pure Mortal Heroic Soul Realm, Lin Wuque felt that he was in great perfection and several times stronger than the previous training!
He could feel that if he faced Murong Tian with his current fighting power, Lin Wuque would be absolutely confident that he could defeat Murong Tian with one punch!
"Buzz"
F8, first 1) send i
The Po Yue behind him gave Lin Wuque an incomparable sense of novelty, but it exuded waves of cool comfort. Under this feeling, Lin Wuque knew that he could maintain a clear consciousness and a calm heart at any time.
"Okay! Very good! The performance of the three of you really exceeded my expectations! Sure enough, they are all geniuses! Hahahaha..."
Qi Shilong's appreciative laughter rang out, and the three people's hearts moved. They each cupped their fists and saluted Qi Shilong: "Thank you City Lord for your cultivation!"
Lin Wuque, Sima Ao, and Lin Yingluo all understood that the opportunity to break through this time was all due to Qi Shilong's cultivation. Without him, it would have been impossible for the three of them to break through their original cultivation levels in just seven days!
For Qi Shilong, Lin Wuque and the others were sincerely grateful from the bottom of their hearts.
"Haha, you don't need to thank me. This time, the three of you represent our main city of Longguang in the Hundred Cities War. As the city lord, I will naturally contribute. Well, you have just made a breakthrough, and the energy in your body is still very weak. Tonight, you will consolidate your realm. Tomorrow, we have other things to do."
The three of them nodded, each found a place to sit cross-legged, and slowly entered a state of consolidating their cultivation.
"Buzz"
Feeling the fighting energy of the Holy Path that was at least three times thicker in his body, Lin Wuque took a deep breath, and the initial fluctuations of the Xifan Yingpo realm overflowed, and he devoted himself wholeheartedly to his cultivation.
Qi Shilong walked gently to the side of the Yuanli River Pool and looked at the milky white liquid in the pool, with a playful look in his eyes.
"The entire Yuanli River has been reduced by about one-third. Only 30% of this one-third was absorbed by Lin Yingluo and Sima Ao, and the remaining 70% was absorbed by Lin Wuque! Haha, a little guy in the body-forging realm who condenses the Soul Moon can actually absorb such amazing Yuanli. It seems that the process of rising to the moon cost him a lot of money. I don’t know what the distance between the seven souls is. The average genius is only two to three feet. I remember that the monster in the first main city seems to be six feet! The greater the distance between the seven souls, the more difficult the process of rising to the moon will be, and the more Yuan Power will be consumed, but the stronger the strength will be after rising to the moon."
"Judging from the intensity of his absorption of Yuan Power, the distance between the seven souls will not be less than fiveZhang, maybe six feet or not. The ultimate distance between the seven souls should be nine feet. I wonder what kind of young genius would be able to reach such a height..."
The shadow of Jun Shanlie appeared in his mind, but Qi Shilong finally shook his head: "Although Jun Shanlie is a peerless genius, he cannot reach the limit of seven souls and nine feet..."
Lin Wuque practiced quietly. From the moment he started to prepare to condense Soul Moon, Kong didn't say anything. It seemed to leave everything to Lin Wuque himself, while it just watched quietly from the side. Lin Wuque was used to this.
"Buzz"
As the holy way's fighting energy circulated, Lin Wuque's silent mind slowly reached his dantian with the holy way's fighting energy.
The origin of the Dou Zhan Holy Law was still the same as before, and it seemed that nothing had changed. Lin Wuque felt it carefully for a while, but still found nothing. Slowly gathering his mind, Lin Wuque completely immersed himself in the practice of consolidating his realm...
As the sun rises, the morning sun emits warm light, and the entire top of the hill seems to be rimmed with a light layer of gold.
The three young men, who had each practiced for a night, were sitting in the warm sunshine. Behind them were three soul moons floating up and down, each emitting waves that were unique to monks in the Purifying Mortal Realm.
Lin Yingluo was the first to finish training. Standing on the top of the hill, the cold-tempered girl looked at the rising sun in the distance. The blue close-fitting martial arts skirt tightly wrapped her bumpy figure. Although she was still a little green, she inadvertently exuded amazing charm.
Sima Ao opened his eyes and looked at Lin Yingluo with fascination. Under the sunlight, the girl's slightly raised delicate profile looked like a goddess descending from the sky. Her fair skin could be broken by blows. Although her beautiful little face had no smile, it was still cold, but pleasant and quiet. At this moment, in Sima Ao's eyes, Lin Yingluo seemed to have become eternal.
"Hoo"
Exhaling a breath of turbid air, facing the morning sun, Lin Wuque also finished his night of practice. His eyes were full of energy when he opened them, and there seemed to be a faint golden light flashing in the dark pupils.
Standing tall, Lin Wuque stood with his hands behind his back, also looking at the rising sun in the sky. The warm sunshine broke through thousands of obstacles and released its passion into the endless distance.
"It's so beautiful..."
He couldn't help but speak softly, Lin Wuque looked leisurely, but this sentence happened to be heard by Lin Yingluo, who was not far from him.
The three words of the boy seemed to be filled with magic power. In an instant, they were like dropping a small stone on the calm lake of the girl's heart, causing small ripples in circles... At some point, Lin Yingluo's cold little face flashed a touch of ruddy color. She didn't know whether Lin Wuque's three words were talking about the rising sun or about her...
"Okay, after practicing overnight, your cultivation level must have been almost consolidated. There are still more than twenty days before the start of the Hundred Cities War. Time is running out. You come with me..."
The mighty Yuan Power instantly enveloped the three of them. Qi Shilong took Lin Wuque and the others into the air and disappeared on the top of the hill.
